aiProviderSwitcher.enableGatewayDiscover.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 when switching to Gateway mode.

aiProviderSwitcher.disableLoginPromptInG.description: Set claudeCode.disableLoginPrompt=true when switching to Gateway mode.

aiProviderSwitcher.setAttributionHeaderZ.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 when switching to Gateway mode.

aiProviderSwitcher.gateways.description: Named Claude gateway profiles. Tokens are stored separately in VS Code Secret Storage.

adapter.description: Explicit experimental local protocol-conversion binding. Direct providers omit this field and keep their existing routing unchanged.

desktopModels.description: Optional Anthropic-style model IDs to offer Claude Desktop for this gateway, used instead of its discovered model names. Claude Desktop refuses IDs that do not read as Anthropic routes (deepseek-*, gpt-*, qwen-*), so a gateway serving its own names can only be reached by sending Claude names it maps itself. The IDs are sent upstream verbatim.

desktopModel1m.description: Which of this gateway's Claude Desktop aliases advertise the 1M-context variant. Aliases resolve to different upstream models, so each one declares its own context window.

desktopRoutes.description: Explicit per-model Claude Desktop catalogue routes. The desktop app receives opaque Claude-safe route IDs; the extension's local proxy resolves each route back to this exact upstream model.

modelMapping.description: Optional mapping from Claude model families and agents to model IDs accepted by this Anthropic-compatible provider.

supports1m.description: Legacy gateway-wide 1M declaration, superseded by longContextModels. Written for compatibility and re-derived on read; editing it by hand has no effect once longContextModels is present.

longContextRoles.description: Legacy per-role 1M declaration, superseded by longContextModels. Written for compatibility and re-derived on read; editing it by hand has no effect once longContextModels is present.

longContextModels.description: Model IDs served with a 1M context window. Each one is sent as `<model>[1m]` in every role it fills, and is offered the 1M option in Claude Desktop.

permissionStrategy.description: Command execution strategy applied when this Claude provider becomes active.

usage.description: Optional read-only JSON usage API configuration.

aiProviderSwitcher.gatewayModels.description: Models last returned by each gateway's /v1/models endpoint. This is informational; Claude Code controls its own model picker.

aiProviderSwitcher.claudeActiveProviderI.description: Currently selected Claude custom provider ID.

aiProviderSwitcher.claudeDesktopConfigRo.description: Claude Desktop data directory (the folder containing claude_desktop_config.json), e.g. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude on macOS. Leave empty to auto-detect; set it when the app is installed somewhere non-standard. The desktop app is managed independently through its third-party inference config library and only picks up changes after a full restart.

aiProviderSwitcher.claudeProxyPort.description: Local port for the Claude Desktop model-name rewriting proxy. Non-Anthropic relays (e.g. gpt-*) reach Claude Desktop through Claude aliases, and this proxy rewrites those aliases back to the real model before forwarding. Leave at the default unless 4180 is in use.

aiProviderSwitcher.protocolAdapterPort.description: Loopback port for explicit experimental protocol-conversion bindings. It is separate from Claude Desktop model routing and only starts when a binding exists. Text and streaming only: tools, images, files, reasoning, and Agent workflows are unsupported.

aiProviderSwitcher.codexProviders.description: Named OpenAI Responses API-compatible Codex providers. Enter only the provider root URL; /v1 is added automatically. API keys are stored separately in VS Code Secret Storage and an encrypted local helper file.

adapter.description: Explicit experimental local protocol-conversion binding. Direct providers omit this field and keep their existing routing unchanged.

usage.description: Optional read-only JSON usage API configuration.

aiProviderSwitcher.codexModels.description: Models last returned by each Codex provider's /v1/models endpoint.

aiProviderSwitcher.providerUsageSnapshot.description: Cached non-secret usage, balance, quota-window, and rate-limit snapshots for custom providers.

aiProviderSwitcher.codexProxyUrl.description: HTTP(S) proxy address managed by the Configure Codex WebSocket Proxy command. The extension preserves unrelated ~/.codex/.env entries.

enumDescriptions: Apply the managed proxy only while using the official OpenAI provider.
Apply the managed proxy while using both official and custom Codex providers.
aiProviderSwitcher.codexProxyMode.description: Controls whether the managed Codex proxy is active only for the official provider or for all providers.

aiProviderSwitcher.unifyCodexSessionHist.description: Unified Codex session history. When enabled, the official subscription runs under the shared "custom" provider id (authentication unchanged) so official and third-party sessions appear in one history list. Resuming an old session on a different provider may fail because its encrypted_content reasoning can only be decrypted by the backend that created it.

aiProviderSwitcher.unifyCodexMigrateExis.description: User opted in to migrate existing official/legacy Codex sessions into the unified history list when the unified-history toggle was enabled. Originals are backed up to ~/.codex/ai-provider-switcher-backups first and can be restored when the toggle is turned off.
